newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NANTES GO SECOND AS PSG LOSE AT MARSEILLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NANTES GO SECOND AS PSG LOSE AT MARSEILLE.

text.p: Nantes climbed into France's second European Cup spot with a 3-0 home win over Montpellier as Paris St Germain crashed 1-0 at arch-rivals Marseille in the French first division on Saturday.

Tunisian Adel Sellimi, Chad's Japhet N'Doram with his 21st goal of the season and defender Bruno Carotti scored as Nantes extended their unbeaten run to 30 games and overtook PSG on goal difference with one game to go.
Midfielder Eric Roy scored the only goal at the Velodrome with a 38th-minute penalty to ensure former European champions Marseille remain unbeaten against PSG in the league in the 1990s.

Champions Monaco won 3-1 at Nancy, who are relegated along with Lille, Caen and Nice, who celebrated their French Cup victory with a 3-0 home win over Metz, Liberia's James Debbah converting two penalties.
